zh.summary: 改善首次启动的进度反馈和运行环境准备速度，增强缓存清理、诊断与更新恢复。
highlights: 首次准备运行环境时显示真实的阶段进度和百分比，加载动画保持连续。
优化 Windows 运行文件展开的读写调度，减少准备阶段的等待；实际收益随设备和缓存状态而异。
自动回收符合条件的中断解包残留，保留当前及正在使用的运行环境；缓存统计也会显示中断目录和读取失败。
加快检查与修复中的依赖扫描，减少重复读取，提高缓存占用查询效率。
改进中断内核更新后的启动恢复，并更清楚地提示内核兼容条件及版本列表读取失败。
修复 Windows 进程退出期间可能误报无法检查后台状态的问题。
upgradeNotes: 更新保留现有会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区。已准备好的运行环境继续复用；准备新内核时会再次显示展开进度。

en.summary: Improve first-start progress and runtime preparation, with more reliable cache cleanup, diagnostics, and update recovery.
highlights: Show measured phase progress and percentages while preparing a runtime, alongside the continuous native loading animation.
Improve Windows file I/O scheduling during runtime extraction; benefits vary with the device and cache state.
Reclaim eligible abandoned extraction directories while preserving current and active runtimes. Cache reports include incomplete directories and read failures.
Reduce repeated dependency reads during checks and repairs, and speed up cache footprint queries.
Improve startup recovery after interrupted core updates, with clearer compatibility requirements and version-catalog failure messages.
Fix a Windows process-inspection error that could occur while the backend was exiting.
upgradeNotes: Updates preserve sessions, settings, credentials, plugins, and workspaces. Prepared runtimes remain reusable; preparing a new core shows extraction progress again.
